headline: Bank of Ghana Cuts Key Monetary Policy Rate by 300 Basis Points to 11%
summary: The Bank of Ghana reduced its Monetary Policy Rate from 14% to 11% to close out its 2026 policy cycle. Central bank officials stated the policy adjustment aligns the benchmark rate with prevailing money market conditions.
why: The Bank of Ghana is responsible for formulating monetary policy, regulating credit, and maintaining price stability in Ghana.

impacts.name: Ghana Monetary Policy Rate
impacts.why: The Bank of Ghana reduced its main monetary policy rate by 300 basis points to 11%.
